ITEM 1 | Two thin slices of meat with pinkish-brown color and a seared, slightly browned edge, smooth moist surface, sitting in an overlapping stack; a small green leafy garnish peeks out beneath them; footprint roughly 8 x 6 cm total, height about 1 cm | 60
ITEM 2 | Small single slice of the same brown-pink seared meat, smooth surface, lying atop the upper edge of the stack, roughly 4 x 3 cm, about 0.7 cm thick | 15
ITEM 3 | Wedge of baked flatbread-like piece with golden-cream interior and dark brown blistered spots and charred patches on top, slightly crisp edges, firm and holding shape, roughly 9 x 5 cm, about 1.5 cm thick | 60
ITEM 4 | Cut zucchini pieces, dark green skin with pale yellow-green flesh, some rounds and half-moons, slightly soft with light golden browning on edges, roughly 1 cm thick, scattered in a cluster about 8 x 5 cm | 50
ITEM 5 | Roasted potato wedges with golden-brown crisp-looking skin and pale yellowish interior, some edges browned, pieces about 4 x 2.5 cm and 1.5 cm thick, dry surface, clustered beside the zucchini | 55
ITEM 6 | Small dark green chunks with mottled skin, possibly roasted squash-like pieces with darker green rind and orange-yellow flesh showing in places, about 3 x 2 cm each, dry and slightly charred at edges, mixed among the other vegetables | 20
